title: Absolute-Frobenius trivialization commutes with finite coefficient change
statement:
Let $p$ be prime and let $X$ be a scheme of characteristic $p$ [def-weil-scheme-characteristic-p]. Write $F_X:X\to X$ for absolute $p$-power Frobenius [def-weil-absolute-frobenius-scheme]. Let $u:A\to B$ be a unital homomorphism of finite commutative rings. Use the ordinary unbounded derived categories $D_R=D(X_{\mathrm{proet}},R)$ of constant module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules] for $R=A,B$, and ordinary derived scalar extension $T:D_A\to D_B$, $T(K)=K\otimes_A^LB$ [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. For every integer $b\geq0$, let $\tau_R^{(b)}:L(F_X^b)_R^*\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{id}_{D_R}$ be the canonical absolute-Frobenius trivialization of [lem-trf-absolute-frobenius-site], iterated $b$ times, with its constant-coefficient identification; put $\tau_R^{(0)}=\operatorname{id}$. Let
$$
c_{F_X^b,K}:L(F_X^b)_B^*(TK)\xrightarrow{\sim}T(L(F_X^b)_A^*K)
$$
be the inverse pullback coefficient comparison of [det-prop-scalar-six-pullback] (1), transported to ordinary constant coefficients through [lem-weil-pbc-finite-discrete-condensed-ring-constant] and [lem-weil-pbc-finite-discrete-scheme-ring-constant]. Then for every $K\in D_A$ and every $b\geq0$ one has
$$
T(\tau_A^{(b)}{}_K)\circ c_{F_X^b,K}=\tau_B^{(b)}{}_{TK}
$$
as morphisms $L(F_X^b)_B^*(TK)\to TK$ in $D_B$. No flatness or finite Tor-amplitude hypothesis on $B$ over $A$ or on $K$ is required. In particular $b=0$ gives the identity comparison.
